consensus.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct strategies: a scalping FVG retest with engulfing confirmation and 3:1 target, and a day-trading FVG limit-entry variant with different timeframe structure, entry mechanic, stop placement, and 2:1 target.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we're going to mark out the high and the low of the first 5-minute candle
entry_sequence.action: Mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 5-minute candle as the opening range levels.
entry_sequence.rationale: These levels define the key levels for the setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we need a fair value gap
entry_sequence.action: On the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break above the first 5-minute high for a long or below the first 5-minute low for a short, and require that the break forms a fair value gap.
entry_sequence.rationale: The fair value gap is the confirmation that the level break has force behind it.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: first we want to wait for a retest of the fair value gap
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to retest the fair value gap by trading back into it after the breakout.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup needs price to come back into the imbalance before entry.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: then we wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed
entry_sequence.action: Enter long when the retest candle is engulfed to the upside after a bullish break, or enter short when the retest candle is engulfed to the downside after a bearish break.
entry_sequence.rationale: The engulfing confirms control by the side of the breakout.

stop.transcript_quote: you want to put that under the lowest area that we traded into that fair value gap. And you always want to give it one tick of breathing room.
stop.rationale: Place the stop beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap with one tick of room.

targets.transcript_quote: we are just targeting a fixed 3:1 return

confluences.transcript_quote: we need a fair value gap
confluences.name: fair_value_gap_required
confluences.description: The breakout must include a fair value gap; simply crossing the level is not enough.

confluences.transcript_quote: Simply crossing through the level, whether it's a wick or a candle closure, just won't cut it.
confluences.name: no_simple_level_cross
confluences.description: A wick or candle close through the opening-range level alone is not a valid trigger.

confluences.transcript_quote: the middle candle was very expansive, showing a lot of force
confluences.name: expansive_middle_candle
confluences.description: The fair value gap should be formed by an expansive middle candle that shows force.

confluences.transcript_quote: especially when it happens through this first 5-minute candle level
confluences.name: opening_range_level_break
confluences.description: The fair value gap should form through the first 5-minute candle high or low.

confluences.transcript_quote: this shows us that buyers are in control
confluences.name: engulfing_confirms_control
confluences.description: The engulfing of the retest candle confirms control by the breakout side before entry.

rejected_strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
rejected_strategies.detail: Speaker uses "one tick of breathing room," which is a fixed-point stop buffer not supported by the schema.

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: you're going to start on the 15minute chart
entry_sequence.rationale: This sets the higher timeframe for the opening range.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: We're going to wait until the 9:30 to 9:45 Eastern Standard Time candle closes
entry_sequence.action: Wait for the 9:30 to 9:45 ET candle to close.
entry_sequence.rationale: The first 15-minute candle defines the opening range.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we're going to mark the high and the low of the first 15-minute candle
entry_sequence.action: Mark the high and low of the first 15-minute candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: These levels are the key levels for the setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Instead of going to the one minute chart, we're going to go to the five-minute chart
entry_sequence.action: Switch to the 5-minute chart for the entry trigger.
entry_sequence.rationale: The lower timeframe is used to confirm and enter the trade.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we have now created our fair value gap through this first candle
entry_sequence.action: For long, wait for price to break above the first 15-minute high while forming a fair value gap; for short, wait for price to break below the first 15-minute low while forming a fair value gap.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break of the opening range with an FVG provides direction and setup context.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: instead of waiting for a retest, we're actually going to set a limit order on the FVG
entry_sequence.action: Place a limit order on the fair value gap instead of waiting for a retest confirmation candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: The entry is taken automatically when price trades back into the gap.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: once the market trades back into the fair value gap, we're automatically entered into the market
entry_sequence.action: Enter when price trades back into the fair value gap and fills the limit order.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retrace into the FVG is the actual execution trigger.

stop.transcript_quote: for my stop loss, I'm going to put it right at the first candle in the fair value gap pattern
stop.rationale: The stop is placed at the first candle of the three-candle fair value gap pattern.

strategies.stop_management: you don't need to micromanage your trades, and you can just sit back and let the market do the heavy lifting for you.

targets.transcript_quote: for our target instead of a 3 to one return we are going to target a fixed 2:1 return
targets.rationale: The day trading variation uses a fixed 2:1 target.

confluences.transcript_quote: we're going to wait until the 9:30 to 9:45 Eastern Standard Time candle closes
confluences.name: first_15m_opening_range_defined
confluences.description: Use the first 9:30 to 9:45 ET candle as the opening range reference.

confluences.transcript_quote: we're going to mark the high and the low of the first 15-minute candle
confluences.name: opening_range_levels_marked
confluences.description: The high and low of the first 15-minute candle must be marked before taking the setup.

confluences.transcript_quote: we have now created our fair value gap through this first candle
confluences.name: fvg_forms_through_opening_range_level
confluences.description: Price must create a fair value gap through the first candle level.

confluences.name: break_of_either_opening_range_side_sets_direction
confluences.description: For longs, price breaks the opening-range high; for shorts, price breaks the opening-range low before the FVG limit entry is used.

rejected_strategies.detail: Speaker uses a fixed 2:1 target and a structural stop, but the stop placement is still extractable; rejection added because the strategy also specifies fixed R-based profit taking as the explicit exit method.
